title: Music-only abstract hybrid
directing_thesis: Treat the song as an abstract material performance: supplied reference stills and generated companion stills alternate while the reference clip's own motion field and dark-material behavior animate the entire film.

entries.story_action: Begin inside the supplied reference visual world with the face partially legible against living black relief.
entries.visual_media: derived still ref_f000.png from reference frame 0
entries.animation_behavior: near-locked composition; low-amplitude reference-flow deformation; minimal warm response
entries.transition: collapse through the resolved dark-material reference state into S02

entries.story_action: First generated companion portrait emerges from the same black sculptural material.
entries.animation_behavior: reference-flow warp increases with rising energy; sparse localized gold response
entries.transition: material takeover through dark midpoint into S03

entries.story_action: Return to an exact supplied-frame anchor; the film feels sourced from the original clip rather than merely imitating it.
entries.visual_media: derived still ref_f036.png from reference frame 36
entries.animation_behavior: continuous source-derived flow and luma behavior with restrained motion

entries.story_action: A brighter generated fissure state raises contrast without leaving the reference material vocabulary.
entries.animation_behavior: moderate deformation; gold fissure response follows smoothed RMS energy
entries.transition: collapse to reference dark state before S05

entries.story_action: Brief supplied-anchor reset before the longest high-drive passage.
entries.visual_media: derived still ref_f072.png from reference frame 72
entries.transition: emerge through dark material into S06

entries.story_action: Generated cosmic-obsidian portrait enters as bass weight strengthens.
entries.animation_behavior: higher reference-flow amplitude controlled by RMS envelope; localized pressure only

entries.story_action: A second generated material state keeps the long section evolving without introducing a new visual vocabulary.
entries.animation_behavior: continued flow transfer; warm response remains sparse

entries.story_action: Return to an exact supplied frame to re-anchor the hybrid in the original clip.
entries.visual_media: derived still ref_f096.png from reference frame 96
entries.animation_behavior: reference motion remains internally coherent; no camera flourish

entries.story_action: A darker supplied frame reduces contrast as the track eases.
entries.visual_media: derived still ref_f120.png from reference frame 120
entries.animation_behavior: deformation amount eases with energy; dark mass dominates

entries.story_action: Generated obsidian-veil state acts as a short suspended threshold.
entries.animation_behavior: minimal motion; material breathes rather than travels

entries.story_action: Use the darkest supplied end-state as the film's material zero point.
entries.visual_media: derived still ref_f144.png from reference frame 144
entries.animation_behavior: subtle living-black motion; near-zero warm response until build returns
entries.transition: gold/material fissures open out of the dark state into S12

entries.story_action: Generated kintsugi-like portrait resolves the climax with the strongest warm fissure contrast.
entries.animation_behavior: reference-flow deformation and localized warm response reach their strongest controlled level

entries.story_action: First resolution portrait reduces material density and opens negative space.
entries.animation_behavior: deformation begins tapering; warm accents reduce

entries.story_action: Final generated portrait holds the reference aesthetic while motion settles with the ending.
entries.animation_behavior: low-amplitude flow and diminishing localized warm response through the final frame
entries.transition: hold final living state through video frame 4334; audio tail ends at 180.640 s
